subject: Milestone-led MAP: commit schedule & uplift proposal
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Collins <sarah.collins@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Milestone-led MAP: commit schedule & uplift proposal

Hi Sarah —

Great meeting last week. Per our discussion, attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that ties NimbleHealth’s evaluation milestones to a staged commit and uplift schedule. High level:

- Evaluation (2 weeks): pilot tests, latency/cost baselining, verdict criteria.
- Ramp (month 1–3): reserved capacity commit at 50% of projected q1 consumption, with a 10% volume uplift credit at 60-day milestone.
- Full commit (month 4): conversion to a 12-month reserved commit at negotiated rates, with an additional performance rebate tied to latency SLA.

Items I specifically want your input on: pricing bands for the ramp vs full-commit, the acceptance criteria for the evaluation (latency p95 & token cost), and the cadence for quarterly health checks. I’ve included a proposed pricing sheet and a draft SOW for review.

Key asks:
1) Confirm evaluation start date (we penciled Aug 17 in the meeting).
2) Approve the 60-day uplift checkpoint language (gives you a temporary credit while Nimble scales).
3) Please loop in procurement if there are specific PO / legal timelines so we can align rollout.

Attachments: Nimble_MAP_v1.2.xlsx (MAP + milestones), proposed-pricing-sheet.pdf, sow-draft.docx

If you’re ok, I’ll update the MAP to reflect any timing tweaks and send a DocuSign starter for the ramp commitment.

Thanks — talk soon.

—Priyom
Priyom Das | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference — Developer-first inference for production LLMs
From: Sarah Collins <sarah.collins@nimblehealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@nimblehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Milestone-led MAP: commit schedule & uplift proposal

Priyom —

Thanks for the clear MAP and the attachments. A few quick notes from our side after an internal sync:

- Evaluation start: Aug 24 would be safer for us (end-of-quarter cycles). Can you accommodate a one-week shift?
- The 60-day uplift credit is acceptable but we need the acceptance criteria to be explicit (we'll only trigger uplift credit if p95 latency < 250ms and token cost < $0.006).
- Procurement asked for the ability to sign a short-term ramp commitment (3 months) that automatically converts to the annual commit after an OK from our finance sponsor — can you show that conversion language in the SOW?

Also, I want visibility into the renewal uplift mechanics: if we hit the performance + usage targets, what permanent discount or rebate do we get at renewal? Please include a clear table in the MAP.

Looping procurement on this email for their timeline.

Regards,
Sarah
Sarah Collins | Head of AI Integrations, NimbleHealth
sarah.collins@nimblehealth.com
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 08:29:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Milestone-led MAP: procurement questions + uplift clarification

Team —

FYI inbound from Nimble. Highlights: they want the evaluation moved + explicit acceptance criteria for the 60-day uplift credit and conversion language for a 3-month ramp -> annual commit. Also they want renewal uplift mechanics spelled out.

My asks:
- Laura: can you draft a short table to add to the MAP that maps performance + usage tiers to renewal discounts (e.g., 5% at 100% target, 10% at 125% usage+latency target)? Keep conservative.
- Stephanie: confirm whether we can include automatic conversion language that requires finance sign-off on Nimble's side but otherwise converts the contract unless they give 14 days notice. Is that a standard clause we can offer?
- Marcus: this touches pricing floor for initial ramp. If they do 50% reserved in months 1–3, what's our minimum acceptable ARR delta? Need a quick thumbs.

Sharing Nimble_MAP_v1.2.xlsx and proposed-pricing-sheet.pdf in the thread.

—Priyom
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 10:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Milestone-led MAP: procurement questions + uplift clarification

Priyom —

Quick: we can accept the 3-month ramp -> auto-convert to annual with finance sign-off caveat. Floor: we need to secure at least 40% of projected year-1 ARR in signed commitments to protect capacity economics. For the 50% reserved in months 1–3, we should ask for a modest signup credit in month 1 to offset first-month provisioning; 3% one-time credit is fine.

Laura — please draft the discount table with conservative breakpoints (5% / 8% / 12%). Stephanie — if legal is okay with the 14-day notice conversion exception, proceed.

—Marcus
CTO (acting pricing lead)
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Collins <sarah.collins@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@nimblehealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Updated MAP & conversion language — next steps (DocuSign link)

Sarah —

Thanks for the notes and for looping procurement. We updated the MAP and pricing based on your asks:

- Evaluation start moved to Aug 24 (confirmed).
- Acceptance criteria for 60-day uplift credit: p95 < 250ms AND token cost < $0.006 (explicit language added).
- Ramp commitment: 3-month reserved at 50% projected q1 consumption, with an auto-convert clause to a 12-month commitment unless Nimble provides written notice 14 days before conversion. Finance sign-off on their side is noted as required for invoicing.
- Renewal uplift mechanics: attached table spells out target tiers and corresponding renewal discounts (5% at target, 8% at 110% usage + SLA, 12% at 125%+ usage + SLA).
- Commercial concession: 3% one-time signup credit in month 1 to offset onboarding provisioning as a goodwill gesture.

Attachments: Nimble_MAP_v1.2.xlsx, proposed-pricing-sheet.pdf, sow-draft.docx
DocuSign (ramp commitment starter): https://docusign.example/sign/NEt1q2
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.example/deals/54021

Next steps:
1) Procurement — confirm PO timeline and any legal redlines by Aug 17.
2) Nimble — sign the ramp commitment (DocuSign) to start evaluation Aug 24.
3) Redwood — kickoff technical onboarding within 3 business days of signed ramp.

Happy to hop on a quick call if procurement wants to walk the conversion language.

—Priyom
